mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1
AND PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%')
AND PRODUCT_CD LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productCd}, '%')
AND STATUS = #{status}
AND DP_STATUS = #{dpStatus}
AND REG_DT >= DATE_FORMAT(REPLACE(#{strDt}, "-", ""), '%Y/%m/%d 00:00:00')
AND REG_DT <= DATE_FORMAT(REPLACE(#{endDt}, "-", ""), '%Y/%m/%d 23:59:59')
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM TB_PRODUCT
ORDER BY REG_DT DESC
SELECT a.* FROM TB_PRODUCT a WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
